SELECT distinct BOND.SEC_ID AS code, FIN.FINPROD_ABBR AS shortName FROM FIN_PRODUCT FIN left join MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO BOND ON FIN.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = BOND.SEC_ID where FIN.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F01}
and BOND.SEC_ID like concat(#{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')

SELECT distinct BOND.SEC_ID AS code, FIN.FINPROD_ABBR AS shortName FROM FIN_PRODUCT FIN left join MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO BOND ON FIN.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = BOND.SEC_ID where FIN.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F01}
and FIN.FINPROD_ABBR like concat(#{finprodAbbr,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')

SELECT distinct BOND.SEC_ID AS secId, BOND.VALUE_DATE AS valueDate, FIN.FINPROD_ABBR AS finprodAbbr, BOND.LAST_PERIOD AS lastPeriod, BOND.PRICE AS price, BOND.NETPRICE AS netprice, BOND.M_DURATION AS mDuration, BOND.M_CONVEXITY AS mConvexity, BOND.BPVALUE AS bpvalue, BOND.SDURATION AS sduration, BOND.SCNVXTY AS scnvxty, BOND.INTEREST_DURATION AS interestDuration, BOND.INTEREST_CNVXTY AS interestCnvxty,
BOND.BPYIELD*100 AS bpyield FROM FIN_PRODUCT FIN, MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO BOND WHERE FIN.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = BOND.SEC_ID AND FIN.FINPROD_ID = #{secId}

SELECT distinct BOND.SEC_ID AS secId, BOND.VALUE_DATE AS valueDate, FIN.FINPROD_ABBR AS finprodAbbr, BOND.LAST_PERIOD AS lastPeriod, BOND.PRICE AS price, BOND.NETPRICE AS netprice, BOND.M_DURATION AS mDuration, BOND.M_CONVEXITY AS mConvexity, BOND.BPVALUE AS bpvalue, BOND.SDURATION AS sduration, BOND.SCNVXTY AS scnvxty, BOND.INTEREST_DURATION AS interestDuration, BOND.INTEREST_CNVXTY AS interestCnvxty, BOND.VALUE_SOURCE valueSource,
BOND.BPYIELD*100 AS bpyield, BOND.CREATE_TIME importDay FROM FIN_PRODUCT FIN, MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO BOND WHERE FIN.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = BOND.SEC_ID AND BOND.SEC_ID=#{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND BOND.VALUE_DATE=to_date(#{valueDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND BOND.VALUE_SOURCE=#{valueSource,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT distinct FIN.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AS code, FIN.FINPROD_ABBR AS shortName FROM FIN_PRODUCT FIN where FIN.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F01}
AND FIN.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(#{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')

SELECT distinct FIN.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AS id, FIN.FINPROD_ABBR AS text FROM FIN_PRODUCT FIN where FIN.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_F01}
AND (FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%', #{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%', #{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR FINPROD_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') )
